questions.stem: What does the term 'metabolic rate' refer to?

options.text: The speed at which food moves through the digestive system
The rate at which all the chemical reactions in the body occur
The rate at which the heart beats
The speed at which nutrients are absorbed

questions.explanation: Metabolic rate is the rate at which all chemical reactions in the body take place, including respiration. It varies between individuals depending on factors like age, sex, and activity level.
